THE UPLOADED SOURCE

Panjab Castes

Read the passage. Keep its context.

Denzil Ibbetson's account of the 1881 census, first published in 1883 and reprinted in 1916.

A record of its period

The 1916 introductory note says the figures and territorial boundaries were already out of date, and that the text had not been brought up to date. This book records census usage, reported traditions and the author's interpretations.

The original contains caste rankings, prejudicial descriptions and speculative ancestry claims. They are visible here for source checking. Their inclusion does not endorse them. OCR errors and broken tables remain in the uploaded text; check a scanned page before quoting exact wording.
